question: Q2: necessity of m7 - change it and recount the exact outcome (ops, time_log2, digest).
number: Change m7: to a nonzero constant (0x9e3779b9, 1 and 0xffffffff all give the same): 597 ops, +2 (+0.0048 bit); to a variable word (as if the prefix were free): 613 ops, +18 (+0.0427 bit). Diffusion test (flip each of the 32 bits of m7, 48 random inputs each, 3 rounds): mean 128.1 of 256 digest bits change (per-bit means 126.2 to 129.9), and all 8 digest words change in every flip tested (8 flips per bit class sampled), so the word fully reaches the digest. m7 is fixed to 0 by the target, so the change is not allowed; the numbers show what the zero is worth.
